title: Cowdrey.MD Markdown Editor
shortDescription: Write Markdown and see a clean, printable page. Share it as PDF or Word.
fullDescription:
Cowdrey.MD is a Markdown editor that feels like Docs and Word. Type plain text and watch it become a clean, printable page as you write.

FEELS LIKE A WORD PROCESSOR
• Read your document as a page, then tap Edit to write
• A formatting bar above the keyboard: styles, bold, italic, lists, links and more
• Format, Insert, Share and More panels slide up from the bottom
• Double-tap anywhere on the page to edit that spot
• Switch between writing and reading and you stay in the same place
• The Back button closes panels and leaves editing, as you'd expect

WRITE
• Syntax-highlighted Markdown with lists that continue and renumber themselves
• Insert tables, pictures, links, footnotes, code, math, diagrams and callouts with a tap
• Find and replace, with match case and regular expressions
• Focus mode, typewriter mode, and editor and code line numbers
• On a tablet, the Markdown and the page side by side, with a ribbon of formatting tools

SEE THE PAGE
• Letter, A4, wide or fluid pages with five page styles, from clean to manuscript
• Tables, task lists you can tick, footnotes, callouts and highlights
• LaTeX math and Mermaid diagrams, drawn right on the page
• Light and dark mode

YOUR FILES, WHERE THEY LIVE
• Open a Markdown file from your phone or a cloud drive through the Android file picker, and your changes save back to it
• Open .md files from other apps with Cowdrey.MD
• Keep a sync folder: a folder on your phone, or one that a sync app keeps up to date, with every document saved in it as a Markdown file

FIND AND ORGANIZE
• Search every document at once
• Folders, pins and sorting
• Version history: go back to any earlier version from the last 90 days, and undo it if you change your mind
• An outline of your headings

SHARE AND EXPORT
• Share a PDF, a Word document (.docx), a web page (.html) or Markdown (.md) through the Android share sheet, to email, a chat, a cloud drive or any app
• Print, or save as a PDF, from the Android print dialog
• Copy Markdown, copy HTML, or copy with formatting to paste into a document or an email

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your documents stay on your device and in the files and folders you choose
• Works offline, with no servers of its own: what you write goes only where you share it

Free and open source (MIT License). No ads, no account, no tracking. Made by Bradley Cowdrey (bradcowdrey.com). Also available for Mac and on the web.
